name: bouncer
description: Bouncer for Claude Code: discover OMP-compatible markdown rules and deny or nudge risky Edit/Write/Bash calls before they run.

enabled.title: Bouncer enabled
enabled.description: Master switch. False disables all rule matching (rules still listable via diagnostics).

interruptMode.title: Global interrupt mode
interruptMode.description: always: deny matching tool calls. never: let the tool run and append the rule body as result context. Per-rule interruptMode overrides this.

repeatMode.title: Repeat mode
repeatMode.description: once: each rule fires once per session. after-gap: re-arm after repeatGap completed user turns.

repeatGap.title: Repeat gap (turns)
repeatGap.description: Completed user turns before a rule may fire again under after-gap.

disabledRules.title: Disabled rules
disabledRules.description: Comma-separated filename-derived rule names to skip, e.g. "no-box-leak, no-any".
